remarks: Welcome to Midtown Estates! Just steps from vibrant downtown, this stylish townhome offers the perfect blend of sophistication, space & convenience. Custom details throughout include hardwood floors, recessed lighting & detailed millwork. The entry foyer with built-ins leads to a sun-filled main level with an open floor plan featuring a living room, dining area with sliders to a private balcony and the designer kitchen showcasing quartz countertops, breakfast bar, custom shelving & stainless steel appliances. A powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, you'll find two generous bedrooms & a hall bath, while the entire third level is dedicated to the primary bedroom with walk-in closet featuring built-ins & full bath. The crown jewel is the private rooftop deck with fabulous city views-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Attached 2-car garage. Freshly painted interior. Move-in ready & not to be missed!
